description: Robustness checks for the drug->target mechanistic-feature lever (results/drug_target_tahoe_full_unseen_drug.json). All numbers recomputed from checkpoints, CPU-deterministic eval.

coverage.note: Coverage is intrinsically capped by the 2000-HVG gene space (most drug targets are not HVGs), NOT a name-matching gap; name+SMILES matching moves 57->58 drugs.

subset_covered_only.conclusion: The full-set null is not dilution by uncovered conditions; on covered conditions the effect is if anything slightly negative and clearly ns.

synthetic_positive_control.conclusion: The target-embedding pathway is FUNCTIONAL and large when targets carry signal; the real-Tahoe null is therefore a genuine biological/coverage result, not a plumbing bug.
